records.text: This is real. They put this out themselves. No, I am not trolling. Tammy Plyman (commenter; spelling and identity unverified) writes, 'Baron (Baron Coleman) merch idea: second favorite host.' You guys are sending the best merch idea: second favorite host. I love that. Um, I also saw people that were saying that we should do 'make him a hot dog,' but it's just—there's—we will definitely be dropping some Baron (Baron Coleman) trolls, without question, in the merch store. Maybe next week or the beginning of the week after that, we will have something for you. But keep sending us
